name: studio-s
description: Read and edit Studio S projects, push a plan in, compile shot prompts, log generated takes.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Studio S app on this Mac. Claude can list projects, push a plan straight into a project, edit shots, return the compiled still and video prompts, and log what was generated for each shot (model, cost, verdict). Studio S itself never generates anything.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: A project's concepts, scenes and shots with ids

tools.name: push_plan
tools.description: Create or fill a project from a plan

tools.name: update_shot
tools.description: Edit one shot's fields, purpose or duration

tools.name: compile_prompts
tools.description: Still + video prompts from the app's own compiler

tools.name: attach_output
tools.description: Log a generated still or clip on its shot

tools.name: set_output_verdict
tools.description: Mark a logged generation keep / mix / discard
